instruction.text:
Fill in the gap with the most suitable coordinative conjunction from the list below.

but, so, or, and
instruction.sound: Fill in the gap with the most suitable coordinative conjunction from the list below.

atoms.a: ssml: She loves seeing friends, <break time='500ms'/>  she loves staying at home with her family more.
atoms.b: She loves seeing friends, ((but)) she loves staying at home with her family more.

atoms.a: ssml: Mollie had a lot on her mind,  <break time='500ms'/> she went to the park to let off some steam.
atoms.b: Mollie had a lot on her mind, ((so)) she went to the park to let off some steam.

atoms.a: ssml: I set my alarm for 7am, <break time='500ms'/> I get up straight away.
atoms.b: I set my alarm for 7am, ((and)) I get up straight away.

atoms.a: ssml: I could eat all of my popcorn while watching the film   <break time='500ms'/> I could eat it before the film starts.
atoms.b: I could eat all of my popcorn while watching the film, ((or)) I could eat it before the film starts.

atoms.a: ssml: Christina loves to dance,  <break time='500ms'/> she loves singing even more.
atoms.b: Christina loves to dance, ((but)) she loves singing even more.

atoms.a: ssml: Annabelle was very interested in English history  <break time='500ms'/> she read some books about the topic to learn more.
atoms.b: Annabelle was very interested in English history, ((so)) she read some books about the topic to learn more.
